subject: general
question: In a certain code 'PAISE' is coded as 'QBJTF' and 'CEASE' is coded as 'DFBTF'. How will 'TRANGLE' be coded in the same code?
solution:
The positional value of letter in alphabet series is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbf24f42e1d482898a5d5d143c7fb8549ccefbba7a5b4a3cb14456af03a4b016.png] 

Given;

**'PAISE' is coded as 'QBJTF'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dc089c2d672c77c0dfa6ab76f7db0fb230ac33b8f42e0ee610515c0fbe899af.png] 

**'CEASE' is coded as 'DFBTF'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ca63ada89fa65bb43adce451424173f3f98d5cd2e1e3eee61e163fc5721da11.png] 

Similarly;

**'TRANGLE' will be coded as**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82db2d0c074d670afe0fe968167c6db0070c55d361542284331a5611c4256221.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option(4)".**
